name: doocs-md-sublime
description: Sublime Text 4 package: preview WeChat-formatted Markdown with the doocs/md renderer

scripts.dev-install: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/copy-runtime-deps.mjs && node scripts/dev-install.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/check-python.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node renderer/test/render.smoke.mjs && node renderer/test/server.smoke.mjs && node scripts/check-python.mjs && python3 renderer/test/py-client.smoke.py
